mechanism: Fluoxetine inhibits platelet aggregation and bumetanide causes electrolyte depletion and volume depletion, both increasing bleeding risk and potentially worsening hyponatremia; additive CNS effects possible.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding, hyponatremia, and electrolyte imbalances; consider alternative antidepressant if high bleeding risk; ensure adequate hydration and periodic electrolyte monitoring.
